description: One listing by VIN: every field of the search record plus its asking-price history on this seller, and battery_warranty, this car's high-voltage battery warranty as its Census EV page gives it: status (for example "Expired" or "In force · 38,200 mi or 3+ yr left"), in_force, and estimated when the term is not the manufacturer's own figure. battery_warranty is absent where the page gives no verdict for the car. asking_vs_similar ("below", "typical" or "above") compares the asking price with similar cars listed on Census EV now (same version and model year, adjusted for mileage); it compares asking prices and is not an appraisal. "below" means at least 10% under them, "above" at least 6% over. Absent for most cars: when too few similar cars are listed, when the comparison is withheld, or when the difference is too small to call. The seller link forwards through censusev.com to the dealer's own page for the car.
name: get_listing
title: Get one listing by VIN
